//: What the bot says back, in one file so there is a single answer to 'what does the bot reply with'. src/lib/bot.ts compiles the patterns and picks a line for the bot running on a device, and scripts/bot-online.js reads the same table for the bot running as a headless process. Kept as data rather than as code because two copies of a canned conversation is two copies to keep in step, and a tester who is answered differently depending on how the bot happens to be running cannot tell which one they are looking at.

rules.//: Burmese greetings first. The word-order patterns below are Latin and cannot match Burmese text, so without this a greeting typed in the app's own language would fall through to the canned fallback.
rules.test: မင်္ဂလာ|မင်္ဂလာပါ|ဟေမုန်|ကျွန်တော်

Hi! I am here and answering on my own device, so this proves the whole path end to end.
Hey. Typing, sending, delivery and unread badges are all live on this side.
Hello. If this arrived while you were on another screen, the listener is working.

Good question. I am only a test double, so I do not have an opinion worth much, but the answer you get is the same shape a real reply would be: written to the subcollection, timestamped by the server, and copied into the room preview the inbox reads.
I cannot really know, but I can tell you the message went through: it arrived here, which means the sender is authenticated, is a participant of this room, and the rules let it past all three.
Thanks for the message. Long replies matter too, because a conversation list truncates them to one line and a bubble wraps them, and both only show what they do if something long was actually sent.
I cannot join a call, so the voice and video buttons in the header are not something this bot can test. The message path either side of them is what this covers.
Sending you something back so there is more than one line in this conversation. Scroll up and down: the list should stay pinned to the bottom as these arrive.
Two messages in a row from one sender is worth testing, because the room preview and the unread counter are only right if each of them lands in order.
This reply is here to make the bubble wrap over more than one line, and to check that the timestamp still sits at the bottom right of it.

fallback: Got it. I am the test bot, so this is a canned answer rather than a thought.
Received. That is one more message through the real send path.
